units.source_text: 源氏公子正在想：“小君这件事办得怎么样了？”

en.t: Prince Genji was thinking, "How did things go with Kokimi?"

units.source_text: 他毕竟是个小孩，公子有些担心，便横着身子，静候回音。

en.t: After all, he was only a child, and Genji felt somewhat anxious, so he lay down on his side and quietly waited for word back.

units.source_text: 岂知小君带来这么一个不好的消息。

en.t: But unexpectedly, Kokimi brought back such bad news.

units.source_text: 公子觉得这女子的冷酷无情，世间少有，便极度懊丧，叹道：“我好羞耻啊！”

en.t: Genji felt that this woman's cold heartlessness was rarely seen in the world, and he was deeply dejected, sighing, "How ashamed I am!"
For a while he remained silent and said nothing.

units.source_text: 后来长叹数声，耽入沉思，吟道：

en.t: Then, after several long sighs, he sank into thought and recited:
